evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Two major risks lower scientific taste despite valid Epistemic Asymmetry retention: (1) Cell-type split & compensatory glial risk: single-nucleus pseudobulks show FBXL5 mRNA is completely flat in human sALS excitatory neurons (Pineda BA9_Exc p=0.628, BA4_Exc p=0.208; Edinburgh Exc p=0.179) while upregulated in microglia (Edinburgh donor-collapsed n=33 diff=+0.459, p=0.00334; 48-library +0.474) and astrocytes (BA4_Astro +0.246, p=0.0316) alongside FTH1/FTL ferritin co-induction, consistent with reactive glial iron-buffering secondary to motor-neuron death, and FBXL5 protein itself is UNDETECTED in Spillman MOESM1 cortical & MOESM3 iPSC DIA proteomics; (2) Indiscriminate iron chelation (Deferiprone 2.5 uM, ~13 uM free-brain exposure) failed in 16 sALS iPSC-MN lines in Bye 2025 (raw mean=+0.115d, med=-0.274d, t=0.41, p=0.686; paired vs DMSO +0.243d, p=0.375, Wilcoxon p=0.860, 9/16 worsened; -3.72d vs Riluzole p=9.2e-9) and worsened PD/AD in FAIRPARK-II/FAIR-AD because stripping iron destabilizes holo-FBXL5, while FBXL5 (KO E8.5 lethal) and IREB2 (OMIM 618451 neurodegeneration) impose a narrow bidirectional safety window.

discriminating_next_test: Cell-type-resolved test in human iPSC-MN + iron-loaded microglia co-cultures evaluating selective cytosolic IRP2 modulation (sparing PDB 6VCD Cys662/676/686/687 [2Fe-2S] holo-FBXL5 and glial ferritin sequestration, with Deferiprone 2.5 uM as negative control), explicitly gating against CNS PROTAC BBB exclusion and wrong-sign exacerbation of already-depleted ALS neuronal IREB2/TFRC (OMIM 618451).

name: CHIT1 / GPNMB / CHI3L1-CHI3L2 microglial chitinase-lysosomal staging axis
technical_accuracy_of_explore_claim: VERIFIED_QUANTITATIVELY: Re-computation in Trautwig 4-center CSF DIA (total N=259: Emory 118, MGH 78, WashU 32, UMilan 31; sALS n=50 vs Ctrl n=72) & Emory TMT (N=101) and Oh 2023 confirms symptomatic-only elevation across all 4 purple-module proteins (CHIT1 q=3.24e-09, BatchOLS +1.7955, p=2.51e-08; CHI3L2 q=2.29e-09; CHI3L1 q=8.04e-04; GPNMB q=0.00162, BatchOLS +0.3328, p=0.00480), with complete absence in pre-symptomatic C9orf72/SOD1 carriers (p=0.2937-0.9918). NYGC Cervical M3 cell-comp OLS (n=198) confirms CHIT1 (+2.4285, p=1.62e-10) and GPNMB (+2.2014, p=1.90e-18) reflect true DAM induction, whereas CHI3L1 (+0.0876, p=0.7517) and CHI3L2 (+0.3345, p=0.1769) track reactive gliosis.
causal_vs_reactive_assessment: REACTIVE_BIOMARKER_AND_COMPENSATORY_PROTECTIVE: Human germline CHIT1 knockout (24-bp exon-10 duplication rs3831317, AF=0.2200, 40,441 gnomAD homozygotes) does not protect against ALS risk or slow progression; GPNMB (#1 PD 7p15 L2G=0.492) is neuroprotective/pro-lysosomal in TDP-43/SOD1 models so inhibition inverts the therapeutic sign; CHI3L1/CHI3L2 are non-catalytic pseudochitinases (CHI3L2 lacks a mouse ortholog).
prior_art_crowding_level: VERY_HIGH_BIOMARKER_BENCHMARK (established CSF chitinase/GPNMB ALS staging & PIKfyve PD biomarker panel; OATD-01 tested only in pulmonary sarcoidosis NCT06205121)
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Air-tight replication across Trautwig TMT/DIA, Oh 2023 CSF, NYGC spinal cord, Edinburgh snRNA-seq, and Zhang TDP-43+ spatial niches establishes the 4-protein panel as a premier cross-sectional symptomatic-vs-asymptomatic staging, ALS-Glia stratification, and lysosomal target-engagement biomarker suite.
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Natural human CHIT1 null homozygosity (rs3831317) fails to confer ALS protection or survival benefit, GPNMB loss/inhibition exacerbates motor-neuron stress (wrong sign for inhibition), and CHI3L1/CHI3L2 lack catalytic activity.
factual_justification: All four sub-nodes (C017-N1..N4) replicate strongly as symptomatic cross-sectional symptomatic-vs-asymptomatic staging and glial/lysosomal fluid biomarkers (completely flat in pre-symptomatic C9/SOD1 carriers), but fail Track B drug-target criteria: human genetic CHIT1 deficiency (rs3831317) does not alter ALS risk/progression, GPNMB is compensatory/neuroprotective (wrong sign for inhibition), and CHI3L1/CHI3L2 are catalytically inactive pseudochitinases.
discriminating_next_test: Deploy rs3831317-genotype-adjusted CSF CHIT1 + GPNMB + CHI3L1/CHI3L2 as a quantitative cross-sectional symptomatic-vs-asymptomatic staging and ALS-Glia / lysosomal pharmacodynamic biomarker panel in Track A/B trials rather than pursuing chitinase/GPNMB inhibition.

name: Classical Complement C1q (C1QA/C1QB/C1QC Intrathecal Blockade)
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Zhang 2026 6i_TDP43_ALS_vs._HC cervical 55-um multicellular anterior-horn Visium spots (N=14 donors) show focal C1QA/B/C upregulation (C1QA +0.9733 [bh_fdr=7.36e-06], C1QB +1.2965 [bh_fdr=1.24e-05], C1QC +1.1986 [bh_fdr=7.60e-09]; 6d_MN niche C1QC +2.37, bh_fdr=1.04e-10), and Scott-Hewitt et al. (Cell 2024, PMID:38942014, 10.1016/j.cell.2024.05.058; PDB 1PK6 1.85A gC1q head PMID:12960167 vs AFDB CLR stalk aa 28-114 26 Arg/Lys basic motif distinguishes anti-gC1q Fab from C1QA/B ASO) establishes C3-independent neuronal C1q endocytosis and RNA-dependent LLPS into neuronal RNP/polysome complexes.
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Bulk spinal RNA and living-CSF C1q/C4B shifts largely reflect glial proportion, center offset, or multi-copy RCCX C4B CNV (C4B DIA p=0.0568, q=0.3369); systemic C1q ablation carries >90% SLE/encapsulated-sepsis liability (IV ANX005 ~150 kDa IgG4 <0.3% CSF entry had 10.7% autoimmune/SAE withdrawals in HD NCT04514367, PMID:41787606); IV BBB-TfR-shuttled IgG depletes 99.99% of 180 nM serum C1q while unmodified q4w IT 48 kDa Fab clears via ~4x/day CSF turnover; and global C1qa KO failed to extend SOD1 mouse survival while worsening cholinergic C-bouton loss (Lobsiger et al. 2013 PMID:24170856).
factual_justification: Per Epistemic Asymmetry, systemic C3 failure in MERIDIAN (C024, <0.1% intact-BBB entry) did not test CNS parenchymal C1q or C3-independent neuronal C1q RNP biology (Scott-Hewitt et al. 2024, 10.1016/j.cell.2024.05.058), whereas RCCX comparator C4B is confounded/null. Because systemic IV IgG/BBB shuttles hit the 180 nM serum C1q sink and unmodified q4w IT Fab washes out (t1/2 ~12 h), C018 is retained in Tier 3 strictly for half-life-extended intrathecal C1q blockade gated on spinal C-bouton preservation.
discriminating_next_test: Engineer ECM-anchored half-life-extended intrathecal anti-C1q Fab/nanobody or intrathecal microglial C1QA/B 2'-O-MOE ASO/di-siRNA (rejecting systemic IV ANX005, IV BBB-shuttled IgG, and unmodified q4w IT 48 kDa Fab) and gate on preserved cholinergic C-bouton (SLC18A3/SLC5A7) and neuronal RNP proteostasis in adult spinal cord models (PMID:24170856; 10.1016/j.cell.2024.05.058).

name: Baricitinib
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Rank #2/107 in Bye 2025 pure sALS iPSC-MNs (+3.774d, 14/16 lines, p=2.56e-7, q=6.85e-6); TDP-43 KD induces neuronal JAK2 3'UTR shortening (dPAS=-0.4391, padj=2.96e-61) & AAK1 lengthening (dPAS=+0.1673, padj=6.32e-16) replicated by Edinburgh excitatory JAK2 upregulation (+0.4907, p=0.0457, n=34); NYGC ALS-Glia enriches gp130/OSMR->JAK1/2->STAT3 (cortex z_diff=+0.7031, p=6.27e-4, AUC=0.7893; cord z_diff=+0.4169, p=1.91e-6, AUC=0.7186; cord JAK1/2 vs Ctrl p<3e-7); NADALS (NCT05189106, n=8-9 ALS) proves 3.80 nM CSF entry at 4 mg/d with -38.1% longitudinal CSF CXCL10 reduction and stable CSF NfL (5523->5796->5504 pg/mL).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: P-gp/BCRP efflux limits Kp,uu,CSF to ~0.05-0.11 (3.80 nM CSF = 0.095x whole-cell pSTAT IC50 ~40 nM [~8.7% cellular occupancy]; 657x below 2.5 uM screen); NADALS ALS had 1/9 PE SAE + 1/9 DVT event (1-2/9 [11.1-22.2%] ALS participants; un-deduplicated in NCT05189106 aggregate AE table); structural/mechanistic JAK1-vs-neuronal-JAK2 catch-22 where JAK2-sparing selective JAK1 JH1 inhibitors forfeit TDP-43-induced autonomous neuronal JAK2 survival rescue (if 2.5 uM Bye rescue requires neuronal JAK2 or saturating AAK1/kinome polypharmacology) whereas retaining JAK2 hits EPO/TPO and JAK1/2 VTE walls; allosteric TYK2-JH2 spares gp130/OSMR->JAK1/2->STAT3 (cord TypeI-IFN/TYK2 axis p=0.843, AUC=0.508) and neuronal JAK2; shotgun MS CSF CXCL10 suffers left-censored MNAR/tryptic scarcity (31.3% DIA / 84.2% TMT missing), is Emory-matched center-null (symp_als p=0.838, sALS p=0.602), and is orthogonal (DIA r=+0.0517, TMT r=-0.366) to the 4-protein high-chitinase CSF glial panel; gnomAD v4 oeUpper JAK1=0.178, JAK2=0.739 + FDA Boxed Warnings bar unstratified chronic dosing.
factual_justification: Human ALS CSF CXCL10 target engagement (-38.1% at 4 mg/d) and neuronal TDP-43 JAK2 3'UTR APA + pure-MN survival rescue alongside gp130/OSMR->JAK1/2->STAT3 ALS-Glia enrichment forbid DROP under Epistemic Asymmetry, but C019 is recalibrated to the Tier 3 exploratory watchlist because 3.80 nM CSF (~8.7% cellular pSTAT occupancy) is 657x below the 2.5 uM screen, NADALS recorded 1/9 PE SAE + 1/9 DVT event across N=9 ALS participants (un-deduplicated in aggregate registry), and JAK2-sparing selective JAK1 inhibition creates a mechanistic catch-22 by forfeiting cell-autonomous neuronal JAK2 coverage.
discriminating_next_test: Resolve the JAK1-vs-neuronal-JAK2 catch-22 at clinically reachable unbound human CSF concentrations (3.8-50 nM; ~8.7% whole-cell pSTAT occupancy at 3.8 nM vs 39-40% cell-free JAK1/2) by testing Baricitinib vs Kp,uu-verified homodimeric-JAK2 (EPO/TPO)-sparing selective JAK1 JH1 inhibitors and CRISPRi JAK1/JAK2/AAK1 knockdowns across BOTH glia-free sALS iPSC-MNs (testing whether 2.5 uM rescue vanishes at 4-50 nM or upon JAK2 sparing) and reactive ALS-Glia co-cultures — barring co-dosing with S07 ld-IL-2 and mandating VTE thromboprophylaxis — before any high-chitinase CSF glial-stratum-stratified (rs3831317-neutral sALS-p80) interaction trial.

name: Apilimod
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Rescues mean Bye 2025 sALS iPSC-MN survival at 2.5 uM (+1.837d, 12/16 lines, p=0.00210, q=0.0173); AIT-101 125 mg BID in C9orf72-ALS (NCT05163886, N=15) reached 3.89 nM CSF (Kp,uu~0.72), cutting 12-wk randomized CSF poly(GP) by 74.4% with CSF NfL -5.0% (6,706.8->6,372.7 pg/mL vs +9.1% pbo) and 0 drug-related SAEs.
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: D045 CSF GDI2 is null in sALS vs Ctrl (TMT diff_log2=+0.0245, p=0.208; DIA +0.0200, p=0.504; C9 only p=0.00598/0.0268); 4/16 (25%, 0 ties) sALS lines worsened; NCT05163886 CSF sGPNMB was unchanged (p=0.352) while Wk12 Plasma NfL rose +39.2% & Wk24 OLE CSF NfL rose +49.7% (n=4/10), and VRG50635 caused 2/6 (33%) encephalopathy/renal SAEs in Ph1 (NCT06286475, PMC12916242) plus astrocytic GFAP+NfL co-elevation & 8/54 (14.8%) drug SAEs in ALS (NCT06215755; PIKFYVE oeUpper=0.550, MGI brain vacuoles), refuting naive benign NfL exosome-flushing for continuous dosing.
factual_justification: 12-wk randomized C9orf72-ALS target engagement (-74.4% CSF poly(GP), -5.0% CSF NfL, N=15 unpowered) and untested sALS status forbid DROP, but continuous PIKfyve blockade hits a human vacuolation/encephalopathy/NfL+GFAP toxicity wall.
discriminating_next_test: Empirically calibrate PI(3,5)P2 regeneration, ClC-7 vacuole-clearance, ATG16L1-catalyzed LC3B CASM conjugation, and LRRK2 pRab10-Thr73 washout half-lives over a strict 14-day kill-gate in C9orf72 and sALS iPSC-MNs to resolve the bifurcated q48h-q72h single-pulse nanomolar PIKfyve sensitivity (6.5-8.0 nM unbound Cmax passes [MODEL_PRIOR] ~79% [64/81] in decoupled dead-zone Model 1 vs ~30% [24/81] at matched 10-20h repair and 0% [0/81] at 24-48h postmitotic repair in zero-dead-zone coupled +PI(3)P->LRRK2/CASM Model 2; reconciling parallel -PI(3,5)P2 -> ClC-7 osmotic swelling [Clegg et al. 2026 PMID:42900584] plus +PI(3)P -> direct LRRK2 N-terminal binding + Rab12/29 + CASM amplification [Kuwahara et al. 2026 PMID:42994990, 10.26508/lsa.202603939]), co-measuring paired intracellular vs conditioned-media secreted poly(GP)/pTDP-43 mass-balance (PMID:27732842; Drosophila C9orf72 model 10.64898/2026.11.09.765393 [PREPRINT]; ruling out lysosomal-stress DPR dumping without net intracellular clearance), microfluidic fast axonal transport kymography, and a prospective predictive biomarker for 16/16 Baricitinib/Apilimod non-cross-resistance: advance ONLY if pulsed dosing achieves >50% net intracellular+secreted poly(GP)/TDP-43 clearance with <5% end-of-cycle ClC-7 vacuolation, baseline CASM + pRab10-Thr73 washout (tau <24 h), intact axonal transport, and zero NfL/GFAP surge.

name: Icerguastat (IFB-088 / Sephin1)
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Modest survival gain at 2.5 uM in Bye 2025 sALS iPSC-MNs (+1.618d, 13/16 lines, p=0.00202, q=0.0173); Zeng 2025 PPP1R15A dPAS=+0.0558 (padj=6.42e-8).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Baseline intake cited mismatched IDs (CHEMBL3545058=Dextrothyroxine, CID:5702546=Resiniferatoxin; true Sephin1=CHEMBL2365743/CID:9561611, MW 196.64); direct PPP1R15A inhibition refuted (PMID:28447936; acts via 1-5 uM GluN2B/PHB2); in Phase 2 NCT05508074 (N=51), high apparent oral clearance (CL/F=580 L/h in ALS; 736-1,388 L/h in Ph1, reflecting <10% oral bioavailability F) capped GeoMean plasma Cmax at 12 ng/mL (GeoCV 66.4%, 61.0 nM, Cu,brain~13.0 nM = 193x below 2.5 uM) with flat ISR biomarker GDF15 (704.3->711.3->704.9 ng/mL), null ITT ALSFRS-R (-0.33, p=0.923), AND 2/34 (5.9% vs 0% pbo) drug-related fatal TEAEs, 3/34 (8.8%) Grade>=3 drug TEAEs/discontinuations, cardiac/cardiorespiratory arrest, and 8/34 (23.5% vs 0%) falls.
factual_justification: Falsified by a non-closable human PK/safety wall: high apparent oral clearance (CL/F=580-1,388 L/h, reflecting <10% oral bioavailability F) caps Cu,brain at ~13.0 nM (193x below 2.5 uM active concentration, with flat human ISR GDF15 and null ITT ALSFRS-R p=0.923), while 25 mg BID already produced 2/34 (5.9% vs 0%) investigator-attributed drug-related fatal TEAEs and 23.5% falls, making 80-200x dose escalation toxicologically impossible.

name: DNAJB2 (HSJ1) Cytosolic vs. ER-Prenylated Isoform Axis
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Recessive human DNAJB2 loss-of-function variants (55 Open Targets EVA/ClinVar submissions, 25/25 single-gene GRCh38 P/LP variants, OMIM 614881; Chen 2016 PMID:26936937; stop-loss neuromyopathy PMID:37070754) cause distal hereditary motor neuropathy (dHMN5/CMT2T) and juvenile ALS, cytosolic DNAJB2a clears ubiquitylated TDP-43 aggregates, and human ALS tissue shows GC-adjusted cortical oligodendrocyte (-0.745, p=3.46e-7 in BA9; -0.618, p=2.59e-4 in BA4), NYGC cervical cord (-0.293, p=5.21e-5), C9-FTD synaptosome (-0.511, p=0.0132), and iPSC-neuron (-1.115, p=0.0455) depletion. Primary 6-cohort splicing/APA scan confirms 0 TDP-43 cryptic/APA events (i3Neuron RNA log2FC=+0.092, p=0.124, padj=0.283), AF-P25686 resolves 2 rigid domains (aa 1-73 & 164-223, pLDDT=67.38), and 25/25 (100%) single-gene ClinVar P/LP variants map to shared Exons 2-9 vs 0/25 in DNAJB2b Zone A.
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Edinburgh cortical oligodendrocyte snRNA-seq is underpowered/non-significant (-0.397, p=0.447), NYGC motor cortex bulk RNA is flat (+0.087, p=0.401), CSF TMT is null (p=0.779), motor-neuron vs oligodendrocyte compartment dominance is unresolved, 1,151-bp Intron 9 (chr2:219284836-219285986(+)) lacks mapped ISS vs ISE cis-elements, and zero-sum splice shifting of shared pre-mRNA from Intron-9-retaining DNAJB2b to cytosolic DNAJB2a risks depleting ER-prenylated DNAJB2b required for neuronal ERAD.
factual_justification: Anchored by human Mendelian motor-neuropathy/juvenile-ALS genetics (OMIM 614881, 25/25 single-gene GRCh38 ClinVar P/LP variants; 55 Open Targets EVA submissions) and concordant human cortical oligodendrocyte, cervical spinal cord, and synaptosomal protein loss; retained in Tier 3 Exploratory Discovery pending sALS spinal isoform precursor quantification, Intron-9 ISS-vs-ISE mapping, and ERAD DNAJB2b safety counter-screening.
discriminating_next_test: Quantify cytosolic DNAJB2a (ENST00000392086.8, 277 aa, excising Intron 9 chr2:219284836-219285986(+)) vs Intron-9-retaining ER-prenylated DNAJB2b (ENST00000336576.10, 324 aa) precursor pools by targeted PRM/RT-ddPCR in sporadic ALS spinal cord and benchmark exogenous DNAJB2a delivery (PMID:26936937) against a tiled 1,151-bp Intron-9 2'-O-MOE SSO microwalk with BiP/HSPA5 + CHOP/DDIT3 ERAD counter-screens across sALS iPSC-MN/oligodendrocyte co-cultures.

name: YKT6 (p.Tyr64Cys Longin R-SNARE)
evidence_proves_hypothesis: YKT6 (C023-N1) converges across exome-wide rare ALS risk variant p.Tyr64Cys (Hop et al. PMID:41917433: discovery OR=2.84, P=9.08e-8; meta P=1.50e-9; AlphaGenome AVI Phred=20.02, top 0.995%), direct 3.46A heavy-atom contact of Tyr64 to lipid DPV201 inside the PDB 3KYQ Longin autoinhibitory prenyl groove (4.29A from Cys66; PMID:32128853), TDP-43 3'UTR lengthening (dPAS=+0.1417, padj=4.57e-40), TDP-43 frameshifting exon skip in its geranylgeranyltransferase PTAR1 (dPSI=+0.1563, FDR=3.26e-6), and sALS cortical excitatory neuronal mRNA reduction (BA9 -0.464, p=4.53e-4; BA4 -0.285, p=0.0263; NYGC Motor adj beta=-0.080, p=0.035).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: YKT6 is pan-essential across 1,258 DepMap lines (mean Chronos=-1.5425, 93.8% <-1.0; biallelic human encephalopathy) with zero known chemical ligands, p.Tyr64Cys occurs in <0.1% of ALS patients while the PDB 3KYQ Tyr64->Cys64 cavity (-85.1 A^3) risks sterically ejecting endogenous Cys195-farnesyl in >99.9% WT sALS, C9-FTD synaptosomal YKT6 DIA is modest/non-significant (p=0.141), and partner cis-Golgi SNARE/recycling subunits (SEC22B, STX5, GOSR1, NSF, GDI2) show null human ALS protein/CSF shifts alongside catastrophic pan-essentiality (NSF Chronos=-2.44, DEE96; STX5 Chronos=-1.13, STX5-CDG).
factual_justification: Backed by rare human ALS coding genetics (YKT6 p.Tyr64Cys meta P=1.50e-9) and convergent TDP-43 APA + PTAR1 prenylation pathology, while extreme pan-essentiality (Chronos=-1.54) and null/toxic cis-Golgi SNARE partners (NSF, STX5, SEC22B, GOSR1, GDI2) restrict C023 to positive allele-split Longin conformational stabilization behind 4 structural and selectivity hurdles.
discriminating_next_test: Execute allele-split biophysical discovery: (1) in rare (<0.1%) YKT6 p.Tyr64Cys knock-in human iPSC-MNs (PDB 3KYQ -85.1 A^3 cavity + 3.46A Cys64-Cys66 disulfide trap), run 19F-NMR/DSF screening for ternary [YKT6-Cys195-farnesyl + fragment] co-occupancy without ejecting Cys195-farnesyl or inhibiting PTAR1; (2) in >99.9% WT YKT6 sALS, test exterior Longin exosite stabilizers or PTAR1 exon-skipping rescue while counter-screening cis-Golgi SNARE assembly (STX5/GOSR1/SEC22B/NSF).

name: Pegcetacoplan (Systemic C3 Complement — MERIDIAN)
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Focal C3 transcript elevation occurs within Zhang 2026 TDP-43+ cervical anterior-horn Visium spots (+1.2920, spot bh_fdr=5.82e-23 across N=14 donors), motivating clinical testing of proximal C3 complement inhibition.
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2 MERIDIAN trial (NCT04579666 posted results, N=249 enrolled / N=247 mITT, subcutaneous pegcetacoplan 1,080 mg twice weekly) missed its Week 52 primary Combined Assessment of Function and Survival (CAFS) endpoint (rank score 123.0 [SE 4.71] vs 126.0 [SE 6.89] placebo; ANCOVA LS mean rank diff -3.0, 95% CI -19.5 to +13.5, p=0.7205) and all secondary clinical/respiratory endpoints and was terminated for futility, echoing terminal C5 failures (Phase 3 CHAMPION-ALS ravulizumab NCT04248465; Phase 2/3 HEALEY zilucoplan NCT04436497, PMID:39960672), while living-CSF C3 fails proteome-wide FDR (DIA q=0.0708; TMT p=0.6225; cervical bulk M3 p=0.1387) and ~43.5 kDa PEGylated pegcetacoplan has <0.1% intact-BBB entry against a massive hepatic C3 sink (Liver=1,575 TPM).
factual_justification: Directly falsified in a 249-patient randomized placebo-controlled Phase 2 ALS trial: subcutaneous C3 inhibitor pegcetacoplan (MERIDIAN NCT04579666 posted results, N=249 enrolled / N=247 mITT: Week 52 primary CAFS rank LS mean diff -3.0, p=0.7205) missed primary and all secondary endpoints and terminated for futility alongside Phase 3 ravulizumab (NCT04248465) and Phase 2/3 HEALEY zilucoplan (NCT04436497, PMID:39960672).

name: Dexmedetomidine
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Verified Bye 2025 2.5 uM paired rescue +1.3992d across 16 sALS lines (12/16 >0d, t=3.250, p=0.00538, q=0.03030, Rank #7/107).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: IV ICU sedative (0.2-0.7 ug/kg/h) achieves <=0.318 nM unbound CNS exposure where ADRA2A agonism (Ki~1.65 nM) already causes deep sedation, hypotension, and sinus bradycardia — a 7,862x exposure deficit vs 2,500 nM screen (ADRA2A/B/C non-DE in Bye RNA-seq).
factual_justification: Despite genuine 2.5 uM iPSC-MN rescue (+1.399d, q=0.0303), tolerated human unbound CNS exposure (~0.32 nM IV ICU infusion) is 7,862-fold below the screen concentration and capped by dose-limiting sedation, hypotension, and bradycardia.

name: CuATSM
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Verified Bye 2025 2.5 uM paired rescue +1.3792d across 15 valid sALS lines (12/15 >0d, p=0.00631, q=0.03375, Rank #8/107; true ID CHEMBL4297372, fixing intake CHEMBL4297643 typo).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Phase 2/3 placebo-controlled ALS trial NCT04082832 (72 mg/d oral, N=80) completed late 2021 with randomized clinical efficacy withheld/unreported (CT.gov hasResults=false; OLE NCT04313166 terminated and sponsor discontinued ALS development), postmortem neuropathology of treated trial decedents (Yang 2023 PMID:37317638, n=6 vs 6) showed no reduction in pTDP-43 burden or motor neuron loss, 62Cu/64Cu-ATSM PET (Ikawa 2015 PMID:25904686) reflects hypoxic Cu(I) dissociation rather than verified intact 2.5 uM normoxic CNS exposure (~47x nominal gap at 72 mg/d MTD bounded by 144 mg/d Phase 1 transaminitis in NCT02870634), and sporadic TDP-43 ALS lacks human genetic support for SOD1 copper-delivery rescue.
factual_justification: Under Epistemic Asymmetry, withheld/unreported randomized Phase 2/3 efficacy outcomes in NCT04082832 (hasResults=false) plus a small observational autopsy series (Yang 2023 PMID:37317638, n=6 vs 6 showing unaltered pTDP-43 and MN loss) do not constitute published powered RCT clinical futility; S02 (CHEMBL4297372) is retained on the low-priority Tier 3 watchlist behind 5 unsolved clinical, neuropathological, PK (~47x screen gap), and mechanistic hurdles.
discriminating_next_test: Require public release and independent statistical audit of unblinded Phase 2/3 NCT04082832 ALSFRS-R/ECAS outcomes alongside 10-100 nM vs 2.5 uM intact unbound CuATSM concentration-response and radical-trapping ferroptosis target-engagement deconvolution in TDP-43-depleted human sALS iPSC-MNs before any renewed clinical consideration.

name: Mycophenolate mofetil
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Verified Bye 2025 2.5 uM paired rescue +1.2792d across 15 valid sALS lines (12/15 >0d, p=0.00293, q=0.02090, Rank #10/107; true IDs CHEMBL1456/CHEMBL866, fixing intake CHEMBL1230607 typo).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Active MPA is 98% albumin-bound (fu=0.02) and actively effluxed at BBB (Kpuu~0.08), yielding Cu_CNS ~20 nM at 1000 mg BID (125x below 2500 nM neuronal screen), carries FDA Boxed Warnings for PML/fatal infections/lymphoma, and had 0/31 responders with 42% AE dropouts in ALS Phase 2 NCT01884571.
factual_justification: Active MPA suffers a 125-fold human unbound CNS deficit (~20 nM vs 2,500 nM screen) due to 98% albumin binding and BBB organic-anion efflux, carries FDA Boxed Warnings for PML and fatal infections, and failed human ALS Phase 2 trial NCT01884571 (0/31 responders, 42% AE dropouts).

name: Tamoxifen
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Verified Bye 2025 2.5 uM paired rescue +1.2742d across 16 sALS lines (13/16 >0d, p=0.00316, q=0.02104, Rank #11/107).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: At 20-40 mg/d PO, fu=0.008 yields Cu_brain ~2.59 nM (965x below 2,500 nM screen & >1,000x below PKC IC50 ~3 uM); cationic amphiphile (ALogP=6.00) induces in vitro phospholipidosis at 2.5 uM, carries FDA Boxed Warnings for fatal stroke/PE/uterine sarcoma, and showed no durable 12-mo ALSFRS-R benefit across NCT01257581 (N=60), NCT00214110 (N=100), and Chen 2020.
factual_justification: Unbound human brain tamoxifen (~2.59 nM at 40 mg/d, fu=0.008) is 965-fold below the 2.5 uM screen concentration (a canonical ALogP=6.0 cationic amphiphilic phospholipidosis/PKC regime), carries Boxed Warnings for fatal stroke/PE, and failed to show durable efficacy across 3 human ALS trials.

name: Lonafarnib / Tipifarnib (FTIs)
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Lonafarnib (CHEMBL298734, FTase IC50=1.9 nM) and Tipifarnib (CHEMBL289228, FTase IC50=0.57-0.90 nM) potently inhibit protein farnesyltransferase in biochemical assays and reduce mutant progerin/Rhes farnesylation in non-ALS models.
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Falsified on three independent axes: (1) Directional paradox: GGTase-III (PTAR1/RABGGTB, PDB 6J74) strictly requires prior FTase Cys195 farnesylation to geranylgeranylate YKT6 Cys194 (pan-essential DepMap Chronos=-1.5425), so FTIs block YKT6 maturation and worsen the exact TDP-43-driven YKT6 APA (padj=4.57e-40) + PTAR1 frameshifting exon-skipping (dPSI=+0.1563, FDR=3.26e-6) defect in sALS MNs; (2) Unbound CNS PK deficit: Lonafarnib (MW 638.83 Da, PPB>=99%, marginal P-gp substrate) achieves Cmax,u<=42.2 nM at 150 mg/m2 BID and estimated Cu,brain<=2.1-8.4 nM (Tipifarnib Cu,brain<=2.0-12.8 nM) vs 70-500 nM cellular IC50 (8x->100x gap); (3) Human toxicity: ZOKINVY causes 90% vomiting, 81% diarrhea, 37% weight loss (lethal risk factor in ALS), 35% myelosuppression, +19ms QTc prolongation, and severe CYP3A autoinhibition/DDIs.
factual_justification: Dropped due to human unbound CNS exposure deficit (Cu,brain <=2-13 nM vs 70-500 nM cellular IC50), ALS-hostile human clinical toxicities (37% weight loss, 81-90% GI toxicity, 35% myelosuppression, +19ms QTc), and direct mechanistic antagonism of essential YKT6 Cys195/Cys194 dual prenylation in TDP-43-compromised motor neurons.

name: SARM1 (Axonal NADase)
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Rare constitutively active ARM-domain GoF variants enrich in human ALS (Gilley 2021 PMID:34796871; Bloom 2022 PMID:34991663; 7ANW/7DJT octamer inter-protomer ARM-TIR latch 3.07-5.47A vs 37.8-65.4A intra-chain, cumulative validated GoF AF=0.000378 [~0.076% carriers] vs benign P332Q AF=0.986%, 97 hom; 0/12 single-gene SARM1 ClinVar P/LP [6 opposite-strand SLC46A1 records]), executing Wallerian NAD+ catastrophe; elevated protein in small-sample C9FTD iPSC neurons (+0.675, p=0.0268, n=3 vs 3); no population depletion of heterozygous pLoF variants in Open Targets / legacy constraint (obs/exp=60/65.1, LOEUF=1.143) or gnomAD v4.1 MANE (obs/exp=60/52.6, LOEUF=1.413; distinct from biallelic KO phenotyping).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Postmortem end-stage bulk RNA is lower (-0.307) due to projection-neuron dropout, clinical SARM1 space now spans three Ph1/2 programs — Disarm-lineage orthosteric base-exchange prodrug Lilly LY3873862 (NCT07883590 [Ph1 Not Yet Recruiting], PMID:33406435), oral reversible orthosteric inhibitor Nura/TRICALS NB-4746 (NCT07369076, undisclosed structure), and Sironax oral allosteric inhibitor SIR2501 (CTR20253552 China ALS Ph1b/2a, NCT07765446 US paclitaxel CIPN Ph2 n=18, ANZCTR 387449 HV SAD/MAD N=82 up to 600 mg/150 mg QD, ASCO 2026 10.1200/JCO.2026.44.16_suppl.12148, SfN 2026 PSTR091 15 Nov 2026 unreviewed congress poster; WO2024125624A1/WO2024222835A1/WO2026086928A1) plus preclinical ASHA-624 — 2026 Commun Chem (PMID:42156967, PDB 9TZY) warns orthosteric BEXi scaffolds risk paradoxical sub-inhibitory SARM1 activation (0.05x-0.30x Kd), undisclosed SIR2501 structure leaves unresolved chronic thiol-reactive Cys311 ARM covalency (PDB 7DJT class, PMID:33944777) vs reversible non-covalent ARM/ARM-TIR T-lock (ASHA-624 class), and healthy-volunteer circulating plasma cADPR (ASCO #12148) is >90-95% ecto-CD38/BST1-generated (PMID:32087251; PMID:16750163) while CIPN DRGs lie outside the BBB.
factual_justification: Core Track B target backed by human ALS rare GoF genetics, parallel axonal protection alongside STMN2 (Krus et al. 2022 PMID:35767949), elevated C9-FTD iPSC neuronal protein (+0.675, p=0.0268, n=6, PMID:42789089), and low heterozygous pLoF constraint (Open Targets LOEUF=1.143; gnomAD v4.1 MANE LOEUF=1.413); despite clinical activity across 3 programs (LY3873862 NCT07883590 [ALS Ph1 Not Yet Recruiting; HV NCT05492201 N=84 completed], NB-4746 NCT07369076, SIR2501 CTR20253552/NCT07765446), CNS-penetrant non-covalent inter-protomer ARM-TIR T-lock glues (ASHA-624 class; covalent Cys311 PDB 7DJT as structural benchmark) avoid biphasic base-exchange activation.
discriminating_next_test: Prioritize CNS-penetrant reversible non-covalent inter-protomer ARM-TIR T-lock glues (ASHA-624 class; verifying Cys311-independent binding via Cys311Ala SARM1 vs covalent Cys311 PDB 7DJT benchmark and benchmarking undisclosed allosteric SIR2501 [CTR20253552 ALS Ph1b/2a, NCT07765446 CIPN Ph2, SfN 2026 PSTR091]) head-to-head against Disarm-lineage 3-chain TIR-gluing base-exchange inhibitor (BEXi) prodrugs (PDB 9TZY, LY3873862 NCT07883590, PMID:33406435, PMID:42156967) and empirically decoupled reversible orthosteric NB-4746 (NCT07369076) across full trough-to-peak and 48-72 h simulated oral CNS washout curves (5x -> 0.03x IC50, modeling missed doses in bulbar dysphagia) in microfluidic WT, Cys311Ala, and isogenic SARM1 p.L223P ARM-GoF negative-control human sALS motor axons +/- STMN2 splice rescue (bracketing the 1.00x parallel microtubule-remodeling Bliss survival lower bound per 10.64898/2026.11.07.764673 [PREPRINT] & PMID:35767949 against the ~2-7x [med ~3x, MODEL_PRIOR] NMNAT2-epistatic MWC upper bound), paired with enzymatic ecto-CD38/BST1 counter-screening (since >90-95% CD38-derived basal fluid cADPR caps 90% selective SARM1 blockade at ~5-10% drop so a -50% cell-free plasma drop implies ~45-50% CD38 inhibition [MODEL_PRIOR], PMID:32087251/PMID:16750163, while CIPN DRGs lie outside the BBB) and anchoring human Phase 1b PD on unbound CSF Ctrough,u >= IC80 (Kp,uu >= 0.30), zero washout CSF pNfH/plasma NfL spike, and exploratory L1CAM/ATP1A3+ neuron-derived EV cADPR:NAD+ while reserving SARM1 KD ASO (PMID:40473123; given ~30-40% residual NADase ceiling [MODEL_PRIOR] at 100x Kd in Binomial hetero-octamer d_lock=6.5 GoF heterozygotes) for <1% ARM-broken GoF carriers.

name: Low-Dose Aldesleukin (IL-2) in Low-pNfH Stratum
evidence_proves_hypothesis: In MIROCALS Phase 2b (NCT03039673, PMID:40354799, Lancet May 2025, N=220 randomized of 304 screened, 90 deaths; primary unadjusted ITT HR=0.81, 95% CI 0.54-1.22, p=0.33; CHEMBL1201438), SAP-prespecified covariate-adjusted Cox + continuous CSF pNfH x Treatment modeling was positive (adj HR=0.32, 95% CI 0.14-0.73, p=0.0070; interaction HR=1.0003/pg/mL, p=0.0011; secondary ALSFRS-R slope interaction F=3.95, p=0.048), with 48% 21-mo mortality hazard reduction in the visually defined (mmc1.pdf pp. 13, 23, blinded to survival) 750-3,700 pg/mL BioVendor ELISA stratum (n=154, 57 deaths, HR=0.52, 95% CI 0.30-0.89, p=0.016; <750 pg/mL LLOQ n=19 had 0 deaths; pooled <=3,700 pg/mL n=173/220 [78.6% LP / 56.9% of 304 screened] HR=0.57, 95% CI 0.33-0.97, p=0.037) alongside sustained Day-112 trough FOXP3+ Treg expansion (p<0.0001) and plasma CCL2 reduction (p<0.05 at Day-112 trough, p<0.0001 at Days 8 & 120; CSF CCL2/pNfH NS at Day 112); Al Khleifat et al. 2026 (PMID:42836993, PMC13642438, J Neurol 273:643) showed inside MIROCALS (N=220) that clinical TRICALS risk shares only r^2=12.7% (r=0.357) of variance with CSF pNfH and contributes less treatment-interaction information (nested dChi2=4.76, LRT p=0.029 / Wald p=0.025 vs dChi2=14.24 for pNfH x treatment; adding pNfH to TRICALS dChi2=44.39; combined model reference HR=0.28, 95% CI 0.12-0.63, p=0.002).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Primary unadjusted ITT log-rank test missed significance (HR=0.81, 95% CI 0.54-1.22, p=0.33; >3,700 pg/mL n=47 [33/90 deaths] showed no demonstrated benefit HR=1.37, 95% CI 0.68-2.75, p=0.38, and 3,700 pg/mL was visually selected from baseline CSF pNfH distribution rather than externally pre-locked), IL2/IL2RA has 0 human ALS genetics, EMA/MHRA/UK MND CSG declined approval pending Phase 3 proof, commercial pNfH immunoassays exhibit ~1.8x-4.5x inter-platform pg/mL calibrator offsets (PMID:31251725; PMID:29054919; cf. BioVendor ELISA in PMID:40354799 vs MSD ECLIA cited in PMID:42836993), Phase 2/3 ALSTARS (NCT07161999, N=137 enrolled, prospectively stratified across 3 baseline serum NfL tiers on 24-wk ALSFRS-R) tests dual-biologic COYA 302 (1 MIU rhIL-2 + 125 mg CTLA4-Ig q14d vs q28d; <0.5% BBB entry, CD28 blockade PMID:30683697/PMID:36920087 vs IL-2 STAT5 rescue PMID:42086904) without baseline CSF pNfH exclusion or a single-agent IL-2 arm, ALS FOXP3+ Tregs risk TSDR methylation drift + NK/eosinophil/sCD25 sinks, and zero prospective Phase 3 trials gated on calibrated CSF pNfH <=3,700 pg/mL have completed.
factual_justification: Under Epistemic Asymmetry, covariate-adjusted survival benefit (HR=0.32, p=0.0070) and <=3,700 pg/mL BioVendor ELISA benefit (750-3,700 HR=0.52, p=0.016, n=154; pooled <=3,700 HR=0.57, p=0.037, n=173) inside an unadjusted-ITT-null Phase 2b trial (MIROCALS PMID:40354799, HR=0.81, p=0.33) with zero IL2/IL2RA ALS genetics require prospective biomarker-gated Phase 3 confirmation.
discriminating_next_test: Complete pre-Phase-3 CLSI EP09c (N>=40 paired ALS CSFs spanning the measuring interval) Passing-Bablok analytical bridging from MIROCALS BioVendor ELISA CSF pNfH (~79th percentile, <=3,700 pg/mL: n=173/220 [78.6% post-run-in LP yield; 173/304 = 56.9% initial-screen yield]) to automated CLIA immunoassays (Ella/Euroimmun/Simoa/MSD; resolving ~1.8x-4.5x inter-platform calibrator offsets, PMID:31251725, PMID:29054919; cf. Al Khleifat 2026 PMID:42836993 where TRICALS shares r^2=12.7% with CSF pNfH and nested pNfH x trt dChi2=14.24 vs TRICALS x trt dChi2=4.76), plus paired immunoassay validation before substituting blood NfL or pNfH for CSF pNfH (noting Trautwig 2025 PMC12082929 tryptic CSF MS NEFL-NEFH r=0.278 across n=77 DIA / n=51 overlapping Emory TMT vs clinical immunoassay serum NfL-CSF pNfH rho=0.64-0.71 PMID:38683209 and serum NfL outperforming serum pNfH on ALSFRS-R slope PMID:32385188; post-hoc NX210c SEALS NCT06365216 NfL<=95 pg/mL p=0.062; note enrolled N=137 ALSTARS NCT07161999 stratifies 3 serum NfL tiers on 24-wk ALSFRS-R with dual-biologic rhIL-2 + CTLA4-Ig and no single-agent IL-2 arm, so ALSTARS cannot directly falsify single-agent S07), then execute an event-driven Phase 3 RCT powered for 247 deaths at assumed true HR=0.70 (80.0% two-sided alpha=0.05 superiority power, critical boundary HR_crit=0.779 [50% probability of point estimate <=0.70 at true HR=0.70]; 138 deaths at HR=0.62 [MODEL_PRIOR]; N~650-750 over 36-42 mo variable follow-up or N~850-1,050 at 24 mo, <5% vital-status censoring, accounting for 0 deaths in <750 pg/mL n=19/220 MIROCALS LLOQ floor and pre-specifying complementary TRICALS + log[CSF pNfH] covariates — whereas hypothetical unbridged 1.8x-4.5x lower CSF cutoffs admit 74-99% of >3,700 pg/mL patients and reduce 247-death one-sided superiority power to ~43-50% if HR_high=1.00 or ~14-23% if HR_high=1.37 [MODEL_PRIOR]) enrolling calibrated ~79th-percentile CSF pNfH <=3,700 pg/mL with longitudinal Treg TSDR (PMID:17694575), CD56bright NK, and serum sCD25 (PMID:32651161; PMID:22343569) monitoring.

name: Ultrahigh-Dose Methylcobalamin (Rozebalamin)
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Phase 3 JETALS RCT (NCT03548311, Oki et al. JAMA Neurol 2022, PMID:35532908, N=130 <=1yr onset; true ID CHEMBL4297672, fixing intake Dacomitinib typo) slowed 16-wk ALSFRS-R decline by 43% (+1.97 pts, p=0.01; +2.11 w/ riluzole) and lowered homocysteine, achieving Japan PMDA approval (Rozebalamin 50 mg IM, Sept 2024).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Efficacy is restricted to early-stage (<=12 months from symptom onset) ALS (prior <3yr trial NCT00444613 N=373 missed ITT), and unshielded 2.5 uM methylcobalamin scored -3.60d (q=0.00246, Rank #105/107) in Bye 2025, plausibly explained by blue-light live-imaging Co-C bond photolysis (hypothesis requiring dark-shielded vs lit control verification).
factual_justification: Clinically proven and PMDA-approved (Sept 2024) standard-of-care benchmark in early-stage (<=12m from symptom onset) ALS (+1.97 ALSFRS-R pts in Phase 3 JETALS, p=0.01); also highlights plausible Co-C photolability false-negative risk in unshielded live-imaging iPSC screens.

name: Censavudine (TPN-101) in ALS-TE Subtype
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Phase 2a NCT04993755 (N=42 C9orf72-ALS/FTD, 400 mg/d PO TPN-101 / CHEMBL124363) showed favorable safety, reduced CSF IL-6 & NfL, and ~50% slower 24-wk vital capacity decline (-8.4% vs -16.5% placebo in C9-ALS); within motor ALS cortex, ALS-TE elevates IFNAR2 both vs ALS-Ox (+0.2793, p=6.32e-8, GC+cellcomp adj_p=3.87e-9, AUC=0.7698) and vs Control (+0.1920, p=6.62e-4, adj_p=0.0376) while retaining intact TYK2 (+0.5763 vs Ox, p=5.52e-9, AUC=0.8382) and STAT2 (+0.3103 vs Ox, p=5.14e-8, AUC=0.7780).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Primary re-analysis of O'Neill 2025 (DS001_ONEILL) shows cortical ALS-TE dropped to 13.40% (41/306 donors; 11.52% in non-C9 sALS), spinal cord ALS-TE is 0.00% (0/331 donors, 100% masked by ventral-horn gliosis/ox), and postmortem cortical ALS-TE TYK2 (-0.0732, p=0.465) & STAT2 (+0.0153, p=0.798) plus bulk ISGs (ISG15/IFIT1/MX1/OAS1/IRF9) are flat vs Control (as ALS-Ox depletes TYK2 -0.650, p=2.05e-12), with zero sporadic ALS-TE patients ever tested, no peer-reviewed NCT04993755 manuscript yet, and no validated living-CSF ALS-TE diagnostic.
factual_justification: Oral LINE-1 RT inhibitor TPN-101 demonstrated encouraging Phase 2a biomarker (CSF IL-6/NfL) and vital-capacity signals in C9orf72-ALS, and cortical ALS-TE elevates IFNAR2 above Control while preserving TYK2/STAT2 relative to ALS-Ox, but extension to sporadic ALS-TE (and whether active cGAS-STING/Type I IFN signaling operates in living patients despite end-stage postmortem ISG quiescence) is untested and gated by lower cortical prevalence (13.53% motor-ALS; 11.52% non-C9 sALS), ventral-horn glial masking (0/331 bulk cord), and biomarker role disaggregation.
discriminating_next_test: Disaggregate the living-biofluid gate by biological role prior to sporadic TPN-101 trials: (1) cryptic HDGFL2 (PMID:38278991/PMID:42854693) solely as the upstream pan-TDP-43 pathology gate (excluding SOD1/FUS, not separating ALS-TE from ALS-Ox/ALS-Glia), (2) direct retroelement cargo (oncology plasma LINE-1 ORF1p Simoa PMID:40050409 [requires ALS CSF validation] + CSF EV L1HS RNA/cDNA) as the subtype-specific ALS-TE enrichment gate calibrated to 13.53% (41/303 non-discordant; 11.52% non-C9 sALS) cortical prevalence (0/331 bulk cord), and (3) ultrasensitive CSF IL-6 strictly as a longitudinal within-patient PD readout (confounded at baseline by respiratory hypoxia/microgliosis), requiring elevated living cGAS-STING/pSTAT2/ISG activity in ORF1p+/L1HS+ vs ORF1p- ALS-Ox patients before any exploratory CNS TYK2-JH2 (BHV-8000 class) test.
